_readme: Evidence section. Every item points at a real file under ./public — the config loader drops any entry whose file is missing, and the section hides itself when nothing is left, so this list can safely hold entries for pictures you have not taken yet. That is why the placeholder entries below are invisible on the site until you drop a file at the exact path in `src` (extension included). `category` drives the filter chips, and the chip row hides itself when only one category survives. `meta` is the credibility line: put the capture date and the host or environment there. `aspect` is a CSS aspect-ratio, so use "9/16" for phone screenshots and "4/3" for photos.
